ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the proposed overhaul of Minnesota's Medicaid system and potential connections to healthcare providers
questions: What are the specific allegations of fraud?
How does the proposed overhaul address these issues?
ideas.insight: The proposed overhaul of Minnesota's Medicaid system may indicate a larger issue with program management and oversight. Further investigation into the system and potential connections to other healthcare providers is warranted.
